raw_response:
I’m still doing the same wheat-maize rotation on these 9 mu. At my age I don’t want to toss things around too much. Wheat and maize are steady here, and I know this land. Some people say cut fertilizer, some say use more improved seed, but I look at what worked on my own fields. Last year the wheat was okay, maize also not bad, so this year I’ll keep the same pattern and adjust a little by the look of the crop. We have well water, but pumping costs money, so I won’t irrigate blindly. Wheat needs the water more at the key times, maize I’ll watch the rain first. Since some people in the family work outside, labor at home is not as full as before, so I need simple, familiar management and not anything too troublesome. I’d rather spend a bit on fertilizer and secure yield than save a little money and have the crop turn yellow or come up weak.
